qrLoading.reason: The encoder comes with the screen's own chunk, so the QR code is drawn in the same render as the key and no tile waits for a fetch; the wait for the route and for /two-factor/enable is the board's loading state. A lazily fetched encoder let a failed chunk reload the page and lose the one-time key (UR-13).
